_doc: What a worn Advancement loadout changes in a real match (BendLoadout; docs/tidebreak/loadouts_live.md). Read at every match start (RingMode.restart): the loadout worn for the player's element (AdvancementStore, read only) puts its live nodes' numbers and its live fighting style on the player's body; a bot never wears one. Classic (nothing worn) changes nothing.
enabled: the master switch. Off, no node number and no style applies anywhere. On is safe by default: with nothing worn every number is today's.

nodes: one switch per node id (absent counts as on). A node whose soak left its gate (tools/ring/loadout_soak.gd: 0.40-0.60 of the games at 30, 0.45-0.55 at 60) is switched off here and noted in the doc; its numbers then read as the move's own.

live: the node ids that may apply (the eight number-only nodes of the plan's B2, less those refused): air.ball.dense, air.gust.full_sail, air.slice.keen, earth.burrow.lie_low, fire.step.quick, earth.wall.thick, water.wall.thick_ice. Each node's numbers are read from data/sway/skill_tree.json changes[]; a node applies only when every change in it can be applied per wearer and the data still holds its `from`.

water.skate.wet_trail is NOT live: its puddles.count and puddles.life_s are in data/sway/moves.json but nothing in the game makes the Skate's puddles, so only its slower travel (-10%) could apply, a pure nerf. It stays out until the Skate leaves puddles. Earth's Steady Point is not in the set either (it needs new fields).

air.gust.full_sail is switched OFF (2026-10-10): the Gust held long became the Air Lance (a spear throw), so Full Sail now widens the plain Gust (2.4 m from 2, lock 0.5 s from 0.45) instead of the grown one; the soak measured the old numbers, and unverified is not live. Flip it to true once tools/ring/loadout_soak.gd element=air nodes=air.gust.full_sail is in the gate.

earth.wall.thick and water.wall.thick_ice are switched OFF (2026-10-10 soak, tools/ring/loadout_soak.gd): the numbers apply and are tested, but the soak's bots never raise an Earth Wall or an Ice Wall (0 casts in 60 mirror games each; they only answer a held stone with one), so the fairness gate cannot see these two nodes. Their rates (Thick Wall 17/30 = 0.567, Thick Ice 23/60 = 0.383) are the mirror's own noise: with nothing worn the same seeds gave 18/30 for earth and, for water, exactly the games the node run played (9/30). Unverified is not live; flip each to true here once a duel or a bot that walls has measured it.

styles_live: the fighting styles whose clips play (state animated in data/bending/fighting_styles.json and poses in data/bending/style_poses.json). Boxing only; Capoeira is parked and never plays. A style is animation only: its picks are timed as the element's own (BendPoses._timed_as).

classic_style: false means a class picked with Classic worn (AdvancementStore.set_style, worn index -1) is not played: Classic plays exactly as before. true would play the picked class's clips (animation only) with no loadout worn.
